## About Me 
I am a trained medical doctor from Ghana, now residing in Columbia, MD.
Currently I am a full-time graduate student at Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health. 
I am interested in research that sits at the intersection of digital health and pediatrics.
I have used stata in the past and have learned python but I never really worked with them so all of this feels very new to me. I hope to gain confidence in using R by the end of this course.
